title: The Tale of Mr. Tod
summary: "The Tale of Mr. Tod" by Beatrix Potter is a children's book published in 1912. When a badger named Tommy Brock steals baby rabbits to cook them for dinner, their father Benjamin Bunny and cousin Peter Rabbit must track him down. Their search leads to the home of Mr. Tod, a fox who discovers the badger has invaded his house. As tensions escalate between these two disagreeable neighbors, Benjamin and Peter must seize their chance to rescue the stolen bunnies before it's too late.
